history.prompt:
Three thin teal orbit lines of different sizes curving across a dark matte stone surface, a tiny gold sphere resting on the innermost line in the lower right. Leave the upper-left 45% of the frame empty. Soft grazing light from the left.

Visual style: calm, precise, premium, quiet confidence. A matte, near-black ground (#121515 to #181C1C) with fine film grain. Light comes from one soft source only. Palette is strictly near-black, mist white (#F4F9F9), muted teal (#08808D), and at most ONE small warm gold (#F5C13A) accent. Large areas of deliberate empty negative space so text can be placed on top later. Flat, restrained, editorial. Avoid: neon, lens flare, glossy 3D blobs, cyber grids, circuit boards, rockets, light bulbs, handshakes, stock-photo people, faces, hands, fake UI, charts, and any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks in the image.

cost_estimate.basis: ESTIMATE: reported token usage x list prices in imagegen.PRICING_PER_M; not an invoice
